name: Backend Engineer (Go)
sample_jd: We are hiring a Backend Engineer to design and build high-throughput Go services. You will own REST APIs end to end, model relational data in PostgreSQL, and improve reliability and latency. Experience with system design, concurrency, containerization, and caching is expected.

name: Frontend Engineer (React)
sample_jd: Join us as a Frontend Engineer building delightful, accessible web experiences in React and Next.js. You will craft reusable components, optimize rendering performance, and partner with design to ship polished UI with strong test coverage.

name: Full-Stack Engineer
sample_jd: We need a Full-Stack Engineer comfortable across the stack: React on the front end, Node/REST services on the back end, SQL data modeling, and cloud deployment with CI/CD. You will ship features end to end and care about quality.

name: Data Engineer
sample_jd: As a Data Engineer you will build reliable batch and streaming pipelines, model warehouse schemas, and orchestrate workflows with Airflow. Strong Python and SQL, plus experience with Spark and cloud data platforms, are required.

name: DevOps Engineer
sample_jd: We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure. You will manage Kubernetes workloads, codify infrastructure with Terraform on AWS, and build observability into everything.
